events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, screenwriter, and producer John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Iconic album
angles.copy: It's been 58 years since The Beatles unleashed their iconic 'White Album' on the world. A double LP that pushed boundaries and remains a masterpiece.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary lead vocalist of Queen, passed away on November 24, 1991, and would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Voice of a generation
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and songwriting continue to inspire generations. Forever a legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Evolutionary album
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a significant shift in their sound and songwriting. Still brilliant today.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, tragically passed away on December 8, 1980, and would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Imagine peace
angles.copy: 46 years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace resonate as strongly as ever. Forever in our thoughts.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music icon David Bowie was born on January 8, 1947, and would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. A true innovator whose impact on music, fashion, and culture is immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on January 8, 1935, and would have been 92 today.

angles.name: Long live the King
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley, who would have marked his 92nd birthday today. The King's influence reigns supreme.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page was born on January 9, 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's colossal sound. What's your favourite Page riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British singer and songwriter Sir Rod Stewart was born on January 10, 1945.

angles.name: Maggie May's man
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, celebrating his 82nd birthday today! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Graham 'Suggs' McPherson was born on January 13, 1961.

angles.name: Our House frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness! Still bringing the house down.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young was born on January 17, 1956.

angles.name: Wherever I Lay My Hat
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! Still loving the common people.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton was born on January 19, 1946, and would have been 81 today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Remembering the iconic Dolly Parton, who would have celebrated her 81st birthday today. Her music and spirit continue to shine brightly.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow was born on January 20, 1971.

angles.name: Take That leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, he's given us so many hits.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean was born on January 21, 1950.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! Get ready to 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car'.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame first induction
events.blurb: The first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held on January 24, 1989.

angles.name: Hall of Fame history
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, rock history was made with the first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who would be in your dream Hall of Fame class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen was born on January 27, 1972.

angles.name: Take That's Mark
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still charming the nation with his distinctive style.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: On January 30, 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Iconic rooftop gig
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert in London. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins was born on January 30, 1951.

angles.name: In the Air Tonight
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A true drumming and vocal powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant was born on September 9, 1960.

angles.name: Charming Brit
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the perpetually charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to darker roles, he always delivers.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake was born on January 31, 1981.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From *NSYNC to solo superstar, he keeps bringing the hits.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved English actor Sir David Jason was born on February 2, 1940.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! A true legend of British television.

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: On February 3, 1959, Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: Forever remembered
angles.copy: Remembering 'The Day The Music Died'. 68 years ago, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper far too soon. Their music lives on.
